enabled.description: Whether to create Grafana dashboard resources for the Pi-hole metrics exporter. Requires metrics.service.enabled to be true.
Whether to enable the Pi-hole metrics exporter sidecar container. Provides Prometheus metrics on port 9617. Required for any metrics-related features (ServiceMonitor, Grafana dashboards, etc.).

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the metrics exporter container. Required variables: - PIHOLE_HOSTNAME: Hostname or IP address of the Pi-hole FTL container (usually "127.0.0.1") - PIHOLE_PORT: Port on which the Pi-hole FTL container is listening (usually "80") - INTERVAL: How often the exporter should scrape metrics from the Pi-hole FTL container (e.g., "10s", "30s", etc.)

repository.description: Container image for the Pi-hole metrics exporter sidecar.

port.description: Port on which the metrics exporter will listen.

enabled.description: Metrics Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to metrics endpoint. (port 9617)
Whether to create a ServiceMonitor resource for Prometheus Operator integration.

DBimport.description: Should FTL load information from the database on startup to be aware of the most recent history?

maxDBdays.description: Maximum number of days to keep database entries.

expire.description: Number of days after which an entry in the ARP cache is considered stale.

parseARPcache.description: Whether to parse the ARP cache.

useWAL.description: Whether to use WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) for the database.

enabled.description: DHCPv6 Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DHCPv6 functionality (port 547).
DHCP Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DHCP functionality (port 67).
DNS Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DNS functionality (port 53).

splitTcpUdp.description: Whether to create separate Kubernetes Services for TCP and UDP DNS ports.

enabled.description: NTP Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to NTP functionality (port 123).

active.description: Whether to enable NTP time synchronization.

device.description: RTC device to use when setting the clock.

set.description: Whether to set the RTC (Real-Time Clock) to the current time.

utc.description: Whether to use UTC time when setting the RTC.

server.description: NTP server to sync with. Can be an IP address or hostname. Set to empty string to disable syncing.

networkNames.description: Control whether FTL should use the fallback option to try to obtain client names from checking the network table.

resolveIPv4.description: Whether to resolve IPv4 addresses to hostnames in the query log and other outputs.

resolveIPv6.description: Whether to resolve IPv6 addresses to hostnames in the query log and other outputs.

advancedOpts.description: Additional options to be passed to the webserver. Can be used to set custom options like TLS configuration, etc.

domain.description: Domain to use for the Pi-hole web interface. Set to empty string to disable.

headers.description: Headers to be set on all webserver responses. Check default value in pihole-FTL.toml for format.

boxed.description: Should the web interface use the boxed layout?

theme.description: Theme used by the Pi-hole web interface. Options: https://docs.pi-hole.net/ftldns/configfile/#theme

prefix.description: URL prefix for the Pi-hole API. Set to empty string for no prefix (root).

webhome.description: URL path prefix for the Pi-hole web interface. Set to empty string for no prefix (root).

webroot.description: Web root directory for the Pi-hole web interface.

restore.description: Whether to restore sessions after a restart. If false, all sessions will be lost on restart.

cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file. Set to empty string to disable TLS.

clients.description: List of Pi-hole clients. Each client can be identified by an IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or MAC address.

groups.description: List of Pi-hole groups. Groups are used to apply settings (e.g. adlists) to specific clients.

tailFtlLog.description: Whether to output FTL log (0 or 1)

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret in the same namespace that contains the web interface password. If set, this secret will be used instead of creating a new one. Ignored if using external secret injection.

password.description: Web interface password. Set to empty string to disable password protection. Ignored if using external secret injection.

passwordSecretKey.description: Key in the Kubernetes secret that contains the web interface password. Ignored if using external secret injection.

enabled.description: Web Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to the Pi-hole web interface. (port 80/443)

skipPasswordEnv.description: Whether to skip setting the default web password environment variable when using external secret injection. Set to true if you are defining the FTLCONF_webserver_api_password variable in extraEnv with a value sourced from an external secret.
